notes.title: Discord
notes.notes:
Discord deleted my official Discord server for Playcraft, and I have no idea why.

Two month ago, my Discord account was hacked, then blocked so the hacker could not use it.
Last week (!) I got the access back and my official Discord server for Playcraft was in good shape.

A few days ago, I noticed my server disappeared. My all the community I've built for the past 6 years.
As the owner of the server, I was not even notified my email.

Discord support is telling me they don't have any backups, so it seem the server cannot be restored.

For now, I suggest you guys to use the Steam forums instead.

I'm also available on Twitter @Playcraft_Dev

Zeroneus.

notes.title: Playcraft Beta Soon
notes.notes:
Playcraft is going to switch to Beta soon! Now is a good time to transfer your creations:
The new updates brings a lot of improvements but require creators to do a few thing to adapt their creations; If you are not a creator, feel free to ignore this message and come back in a few weeks for the Beta release.

1) First, If you want to transfer your creation but don't have access to the game, DM me a message (https://discordapp.com/invite/playcraft).
2) Once in the game, load your creations by creating a game server and go into LOAD (Escape) then select mod.io, you should find them here.
3) Make sure they still work, a lot of things have changed and you might need to fix a few things.
4) Then you can Save again and reupload your creation (Escape).

Let me know if you need help, and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Closed Alpha Tests + Premium!
notes.notes:
Playcraft is evolving! Big updates + Alpha-test AND we are switching from free-to-play to premium with a small price. All previously paid content will be accessible for all! And if you purchased the DLC, you will have full access to the game.

We are now entering a closed Alpha-Test phase, Playcraft will be inaccessible during this phase.
To participate to the Alpha-test, hit me up (Zeroneus) on Discord https://discord.gg/d7Uywf9

Get ready for Playcraft - next level!

notes.title: Dev Update!
notes.notes:
Playcrafters, It's been a while,

A Steam update is overdue: Development is progressing!
Playcraft early access Alpha has receive a few updates this year: more info on Discord [url=https://discord.com/invite/playcraft]here[/url]

Since, I've been working on new, bigger systems, that will expand your creation power to another level! Those systems require longer development cycles though, and I invite you to come back in a few months to get a first taste.

Leading up to the full release of Playcraft MetaWorlds, next year, we are planning to change our model from Free-to-play to Premium. We are going to make it as affordable as possible for players and creators. Given our limited resources, I believe this model will allow us to develop the best experience possible while assuring a sustainable future for the development of our creative platform.

Our long term goal is to allow you, as creators, to monetise your creation. We will make sure this can be done the best way possible, but more on that later.

Thank you for following this project!
Have fun creating,
Zeroneus

notes.title: Playcraft First Month Updates
notes.notes:
Dear Playcrafters,

Thank you for being part of this adventure!

In just a few weeks, we are now a community of 100k Players, with a solid and active player base. But more importantly: [b]Your creativity is amazing![/b]

The first month of early access has as been about bug fixing, optimizations, as well as new features, in totals, 97 improvements (full list down there).

I spend some time to reach for influencer and press (help me spread the world about Playcraft on forums and social media or by contacting your favorite influencer)

I also participated in a game show, where I meet great people who might help for the future of Playcraft!

Hello Playcrafters ! Today start the first contest for game creation ! 

We want it spooky, funny, this is Halloween ! 
You have untill Wednesday 30th October to create your map.
Rules are simple : make a small map plateformer game, using any type of objects you want ! Let's be creative ! 
On Wednesday you'll be able to share your map here and people will vote for it on Discord 
The winner's map will be featured on social medias.

Have FUN Playcrafters !
